systemTrayConsent: Loads the tray component into Windows Explorer. Turning this off disconnects it.
systemTrayWaiting: Waiting for applications to publish their tray icons. Some apps may need to be reopened.
systemTrayInputUnavailable: Unable to open the Windows input method. Use the input indicator on the Windows taskbar.
systemTrayInputTimeout: The Windows input method timed out. Use the taskbar input indicator.
systemTrayInputPending: Windows is responding slowly. The input window may appear later.
systemNotificationsDenied: Notification access is off. Enable it in Windows privacy settings.
systemNotificationsLiveUnavailable: Live updates are unavailable. Refresh manually.
systemTrayHintsDescription: A blue dot marks a received tray hint and clears when hint history is cleared. It is not an app unread count. Only the latest 50 tray hints are held in memory; they clear on exit.
systemTrayUnsupported: The independent tray currently supports x64 Windows 10 version 2004 or newer.
systemTrayMissing: This build does not include the tray component. Use a build that includes it.
systemTrayHashFailed: The tray component failed its integrity check and was not loaded.
systemTrayVersionFailed: The tray component version does not match and was not loaded.
systemTrayExplorerMissing: Windows Explorer's tray is unavailable. Reconnecting automatically.
systemTrayHookFailed: Could not connect to the tray. The original Windows tray continues working.
systemTraySourceFailed: Tray connection source verification failed. Disconnected.
systemTrayDataFailed: Incompatible tray data received. Processing stopped.
systemTrayUpdatesSkipped: Some updates could not be received in time. Refresh the connection to resync.
windowMotionHint: Animate only when window content is available.
searchEnabled: Show search on the dock and enable its shortcut
searchHint: Type an application or file name. Enter to open; Esc to close.
searchScopeHint: File results come from the running Everything application. Its indexed drives, exclusions and search syntax apply. Application shortcuts are also searched.
searchShortcutBusy: The shortcut is used by another application. Open Search from the dock and choose another shortcut in Search locations.
searchLimited: Showing the first 100 results; refine your query
searchAppsUnavailable: The application list could not be loaded.
organizerEnabled: Show desktop organizer on the dock
pecoHint: Manage desktop sections, items and layouts
pecoUnavailable: PecoFence was not found. Choose its installed program or CLI executable.
pecoNotRunning: PecoFence is not running. Start it, then refresh.
pecoTimeout: PecoFence did not reply in time. The operation may have completed. Close its open menus or dialogs and refresh before trying again.
pecoReadTimeout: PecoFence did not reply in time. Close its open menus or dialogs, then refresh.
pecoOperationFailed: PecoFence could not complete the operation.
pecoInvalidReply: PecoFence returned an unreadable reply. Refresh to check the current state.
pecoVirtualOnly: Items can only be moved between virtual sections here. Moves involving folder portals are unavailable.
pecoPartialMove: Some items were skipped. Refresh to check their current sections before trying again.
pecoInvalidSelection: The selected item is no longer valid. Refresh and select it again.
pecoNameRequired: Enter a name between 1 and 100 characters, without control characters.
pecoDesktopOnly: Drop only desktop items already managed by PecoFence. Files from other locations are left unchanged.
pecoSelectItems: Select one or more items first.
fenceLoadFailed: This section could not be loaded
fenceRestoreAsk: Restore layout “{0}”? Section positions and item grouping will change. Files will not be moved.
everythingUnavailable: Everything is not available. Start Everything and check its instance name. Only application shortcuts are shown.
everythingConnectionUnavailable: Everything is not connected. Start Everything and check its instance name.
everythingTimeout: Everything did not reply in time. Try a narrower query.
everythingInvalidReply: Everything returned an invalid search reply.
everythingInstanceHint: Leave empty for the standard instance. For a named instance, enter its name (for example, 1.5a).
searchEmptyHint: Type a name, or use Everything search syntax
fenceEmptyHint: Drop desktop items already managed by PecoFence
searchInvalidScope: This folder is unavailable. Choose another search scope.
trayMenuPlacement: Move app menus near the tray
trayMenuPlacementDesc: Experimental: adjusts only standard menus with a confirmed owner. A menu may move after it appears.
nativeMotionNeedsActivation: Click Enable; administrator confirmation is required
nativeMotionWaitingForWindow: Connected; waiting for a window transition
nativeMotionNotProcessing: No window transitions handled; using Windows animation
nativeMotionFallback: The latest window transition used Windows animation
nativeMotionUnsupported: This Windows build is not supported; using system animation
nativeMotionSignOut: The component was updated; it takes effect after the next sign-in
nativeMotionFailed: Could not enable; using system animation
nativeMotionInitializationFailed: The animation component could not initialize
nativeMotionCompositorUnavailable: Cannot connect to Desktop Window Manager
nativeMotionLoadFailed: Windows could not load the animation component
nativeMotionActivationTimeout: Loading the animation component timed out
nativeMotionCacheFailed: Cannot prepare the animation component directory
nativeMotionNoResponse: The animation component did not respond
nativeMotionMissing: Animation files are missing; extract the complete release again
nativeMotionFilesChanged: Component verification failed; extract the complete release again
nativeMotionAccessDenied: Windows blocked activation; using system animation
nativeMotionRequestExpired: The activation request expired; try again
nativeMotionMappingFailed: Cannot connect to the animation component; using system animation
nativeMotionPaused: Animation paused; switch this option off and on to resume
nativeMotionSystemOff: Windows animation or the Dock is disabled
windowHideAnimation: Use close animation when hiding to the tray
